answer: A newcomer earns standing by wandering a ridge between three marble cairns, lighting a signal fire at each at dusk — flame photo, wind reading, and timestamp, witnessed by a fellow traveller. Two ridge keepers verify the log within five days, checking each flame against the cairn register and the wind against ridge records. A copied photo, a fire the cairn never held, or a missing cairn voids the season, burns the 60-credit stake, and bars the sponsor a year. One honest season costs 60 credits; a thousand fakes need 1,000 wanderings and 3,000 fires, each checked against a real cairn.
